trial.heading: 1. 7-Day Free Trial
trial.body1: Every new AdsLab subscriber gets a 7-day free trial starting from the day your credit card is saved. During the trial you can use the full feature set of your selected plan and cancel anytime with no charge.
trial.body2: If you do not cancel before the trial ends, billing begins automatically on the following day for the selected plan. We send email reminders 2 days, 1 day, and on the trial-end date so you can decide.

prorated.heading: 2. Pro-rated Refund for New Billing Cycle
prorated.body: After a new billing charge (post-trial, or monthly/annual renewal), you are eligible for a refund within the first 7 days of the cycle. The refundable amount is calculated proportionally to the remaining days of the cycle (pro-rated).
prorated.exampleBody: Subscribed to Starter ฿1,490/month, used for 3 days, requested refund

cancel.heading: 3. Cancelling Your Subscription
cancel.body: You can cancel anytime from Settings → Billing → Cancel subscription. After cancelling:
cancel.item1: You retain access until the end of the current billing cycle (no automatic refund).
cancel.item2: No auto-renewal in the next cycle.
cancel.item3: Your data is kept in the system for 90 days. If you resubscribe within that window, all your data is restored.

nonRefundable.heading: 4. Non-Refundable Cases
nonRefundable.body: Refunds are not available in the following cases:
nonRefundable.item1: Past the first 7 days of a billing cycle (you can still cancel to prevent renewal).
nonRefundable.item2: Account suspended for violation of the Terms of Service.
nonRefundable.item3: Payment made through channels other than Omise (e.g., direct transfer — not supported in the current Phase).

process.heading: 5. How to Request a Refund
process.step1: Go to Settings → Billing in your dashboard.
process.step2: On the target Invoice, click Request refund.
process.step3: The system processes the refund back to your original card via Omise within 5–10 business days.
process.step4: You will receive an email confirmation once the refund is complete.
process.specialContact: For issues or special-circumstance refund requests, contact us at

planChange.heading: 6. Changing Plans
planChange.body: If you upgrade (e.g., Starter → Pro) mid-cycle, the system charges the pro-rated difference for the remaining days. If you downgrade, the new plan takes effect at the next billing cycle (no difference refunded).

english.heading: Refund Policy (Summary)
english.trial: 7-day free trial: No charge during trial period. Cancel anytime via Settings → Billing.
english.prorated: Pro-rated refund within 7 days of new billing cycle: Eligible amount calculated as payment × (remaining_days ÷ total_days_in_period).
english.cancel: Cancellation: Access continues until end of current billing period. No refund issued on cancellation itself, but no further charges.
english.nonRefundable: Non-refundable cases: Beyond 7-day window; suspended accounts due to ToS violation.

privacy.metaDescription: How AdsLab collects, uses, and protects your data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.body: AdsLab ("we", "our") is a SaaS platform for media buyers and digital marketing agencies. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data in compliance with Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA, 2019) and international standards (GDPR).

s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
s2.item1: Account info: email, name, password (stored as hash)
s2.item2: Workspace info: agency name, team members, role of each member
s2.item3: Meta advertising data: when you click "Connect Meta" we fetch ad accounts, campaigns, and insights via Meta Marketing API based on permissions you grant
s2.item4: Usage data: login logs, API calls, error events
s2.item5: Cookies: session cookie only (authentication). No tracking cookies.

s3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
s3.item1: Provide the platform (dashboard, AI report, optimization)
s3.item2: Send required emails (verification, password reset, reports)
s3.item3: Generate AI insights via OpenRouter (Claude, Gemini) — your campaign data is sent for processing and is NOT retained by AI providers
s3.doNot: We do NOT: sell, share with advertisers, or use your data to train AI models.

s4.title: 4. Third-Party Service Providers
s4.item1: Meta Platforms — advertising data source (via Marketing API)

s5.title: 5. Data Retention
s5.item1: Account data: while your account is active + 90 days after deletion
s5.item2: Cached ad data: up to 90 days for historical reporting
s5.item4: After the retention window, data is permanently purged from backups

s6.title: 6. Your Rights (PDPA / GDPR)
s6.item3: Delete your account and all data (see <deletionLink>Data Deletion</deletionLink>)
s6.item4: Withdraw consent (disconnect Meta at any time)
s6.item6: Lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Committee (PDPC) if you believe we have violated your rights

s7.title: 7. Security
s7.item1: All data in transit is encrypted with TLS (HTTPS)
s7.item2: Passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes (irreversible)
s7.item3: Meta access tokens are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM
s7.item4: Session cookies are httpOnly, secure, sameSite=lax

s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
s8.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email at least 14 days before they take effect.

dataDeletion.metaDescription: How to request deletion of your data from AdsLab.
dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion
dataDeletion.intro: Sorry to see you go — we keep only the data we need and delete it on request.

s1.title: 1. Delete via the App (Recommended)
s1.timing: Deletion completes within 30 days (including from backups)
s1.note: Note: in-app account deletion will be available in Phase 2 — for now please use method 2 below.

s2.title: 2. Delete via Email
s2.item1: The email you used to sign up for AdsLab
s2.ack: We will acknowledge your request within 3 business days and complete deletion within 30 days.

s3.title: 3. Deletion via Facebook
s3.body: If you revoke permission from Facebook (Settings → Apps and Websites → AdsLab → Remove), Meta will notify us and we will delete your Meta connection within 7 days. (Your AdsLab account will remain — use method 1 or 2 if you want to fully delete the account.)

s4.title: 4. What Data Will Be Deleted
s4.item2: Workspace / Tenant where you are sole Owner (no other members)
s4.item3: Meta access token + cached ad accounts
s4.item4: Cached campaign insights and AI reports
s4.retained: Data that may be retained: Invoices / receipts as required by Thai tax law (5 years).
